infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aahaas Driver uses your location while a trip day is running to count the kilometres you drive and show operations where the car is.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keep counting your kilometres when the phone is locked or another app (like Maps) is open. Tracking runs only between Start day and End day.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos of your vehicle for the 2-monthly vehicle check.
